description: This Java class 'ProductEvents' contains event handling methods related to product management within an e-commerce framework. It handles actions like updating keywords, managing product associations, clearing view history, updating shipping info, managing product features and categories, sending 'tell a friend' emails, and managing product comparison lists.

classes.name: ProductEvents
classes.description: Handles various product-related events and actions within the e-commerce system.

methods.name: updateAllKeywords
methods.description: Updates or adds keywords for all products based on permission checks and search conditions.

methods.name: updateProductAssoc
methods.description: Updates product association information based on specified update mode and parameters.

methods.name: clearLastViewedCategories
methods.description: Clears the last viewed categories stored in session.

methods.name: clearLastViewedProducts
methods.description: Clears the last viewed products stored in session.

methods.name: clearAllLastViewed
methods.description: Clears all history of last viewed categories, products, and searches.

methods.name: updateProductQuickAdminShipping
methods.description: Quickly updates shipping-related dimensions, weights, and features for products or variants.

methods.name: setOrCreateProdFeature
methods.description: Finds or creates a product feature of a specific type and applies it to a product.

methods.name: updateProductQuickAdminSelFeat
methods.description: Updates or adds selectable features (like variant features) to products or their variants.

methods.name: checkUpdateFeatureApplByDescription
methods.description: Checks, adds, or removes product feature applications based on description matching and product type.

methods.name: removeFeatureApplsByFeatureTypeId
methods.description: Removes feature applications of a specific feature type from a product and its variants.

methods.name: removeProductFeatureAppl
methods.description: Removes a specific product feature application from a product.

methods.name: addProductToCategories
methods.description: Adds a product to one or more categories.

methods.name: updateProductCategoryMember
methods.description: Updates the 'thruDate' for a product's category membership.

methods.name: addProductFeatures
methods.description: Adds features to a product based on provided feature IDs and types.

methods.name: setDefaultStoreSettings
methods.description: Sets default locale, currency, and timezone based on store settings and user login info.

methods.name: checkStoreCustomerRole
methods.description: Verifies that the logged-in user has the customer role associated with the store if required.

methods.name: tellAFriend
methods.description: Sends a 'Tell a Friend' email for a product, using store email settings.

methods.name: getProductCompareList
methods.description: Retrieves the current product comparison list stored in session.

methods.name: addProductToComparisonList
methods.description: Adds a product to the comparison list, with a check to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: removeProductFromComparisonList
methods.description: Removes a product from the comparison list.

methods.name: parseBigDecimalFromParameter
methods.description: Parses a BigDecimal value from request parameters, converting empty strings to null.

methods.name: addProductTags
methods.description: Adds tags to a product by parsing input string and creating keyword entries.
